description.tr: Şair. Osmanlı Suriye valisi babasını Şam'da zehirlemişti. Seyyide Zeyneb türbesine defnedildi.
description.en: Poet. The Ottoman governor of Syria had poisoned his father in Damascus and he was buried in the mau
